neighborhood.distance_policy: retain a record iff its geometry (footprint polygon, or point for places) intersects the union of 1600 m geodesic buffers, i.e. ST_DWITHIN(geom, anchor_point, 1600), around every anchor that has a coordinate (>=1.5 km required); anchors without a coordinate (raw address strings, failed geocodes) cannot be buffered and are recorded only
neighborhood.containment_policy: intersection, not centroid: a footprint is kept when any part is within 1600 m of an anchor even if its centroid is farther or in another H3 cell; the H3 r7 disk (k=2 rings around each anchor cell, >=4 km reach beyond any point of the anchor cell) is only the pruning cover; bbox-overlap prefilter [-95.351775, 36.224315, -95.313907, 36.254857] precedes the exact predicate
neighborhood.possible_misses: objects whose keyed (centroid) H3 r7 cell lies outside the k-ring disk but whose geometry reaches within R of an anchor (needs a footprint > ~2.5 km across); polygons are not clipped to the buffer (whole footprint retained)
neighborhood.coverage_hole_check: COUNT(*) re-run with a k=3 disk must equal the k=2 count
